narrative_passages.title: Rain before the day of Badr
narrative_passages.treatment_reason: the eve of a battle; no combat is played

summary_for_children: Al-Anfal speaks to believers about trust in Allah, staying united, not quarrelling, and choosing peace when it is offered.
environment_concept: A field where rain falls and the sand grows firm (8:11), a circle of stones that glows (8:2) and a green hill of peace (8:61).
architecture_and_scenery: Open plain with wells, low dunes, a camp of plain tents and a hill to look from. No battle is shown.

palette.lighting: Overcast turning to rain, then clear

areas.name: Field of Rain
areas.description: Rain falls and the sand firms under the child's feet.

areas.name: Circle of Hearts
areas.description: A circle of stones that glows when 8:2 is read.

areas.name: Hill of Peace
areas.description: A hill where a white banner of peace lifts in the breeze.

activities.name: Walk on firm ground
activities.description: Carry rain clouds over the dry sand; the ground turns firm and green.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Don't quarrel
activities.description: Solve a teamwork puzzle that only works when every piece cooperates.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: History is told as explanation, clearly labelled; no fighting is shown.
learning_objectives: Know that Allah's help comes with patience

status.playable_environment: first version built: a composed world (mountain, stones) with 1 hands-on activity in the scene
status.testing: not tested yet: written and type-checked, not yet checked on screen

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

adventure_world.title: The Camp of Cooperation
adventure_world.source: "Quran Adventure: First 10 Unique Worlds" with the rule "114 unique game experiences" (2026-11-04); replaces the first adventure version built from the earlier design table
adventure_world.status: second version built for the web: each world now has its own core mechanic; draft, unreviewed; checked in headless Chromium with software WebGL only, not on phones or real GPUs
adventure_world.note: The new-look adventure world for this surah. It is a separate design from the composed scene this record describes; both are kept until reviewers choose.
adventure_world.core_play: A planning puzzle: route rain water from the spring through channels and gates so every cistern fills and little is wasted. A wrong plan is not a failure: the spring refills and you try again.

unique_world.visual_theme: Grey rainy camp with channels and cisterns

primary_mechanic.text: Open a sluice and turn gates in time so rain water fills three cisterns without spilling (8:11).

unique_world.learning_objective: Cooperation and setting things right between people (8:1, 8:63)
